faq: Can existing users update without reinstalling?
Yes, if the new Flutter app keeps the same app ID and signing. Users get it as a normal store update. We test the update path from your current version in Premium, and plan it in Standard.
What happens to in-app purchases and subscribers?
If we keep the same app listing, store purchases stay with it, and we rebuild the purchase code to match. We check each store's rules before changing anything related to billing.
Yes. Flutter can be added module by module into an existing native app. We can plan a gradual path if a full switch is too risky, though each package covers a single defined step.
Is Flutter right for my app?
Often, for apps with standard screens, lists, forms and payments. Apps that rely heavily on special hardware or advanced graphics may need extra native code. We tell you honestly before you commit.
